room_static_constructor.claim: Creates MAPCHIP_ARRAY outer length 2, with inner lengths 196 and 16, and initializes the image tables.

room_init_map_chips.claim: Computes floor != 0, selects MAPCHIP_ARRAY[0/1], allocates width*height MapChips, and reads the selected row by flat index.

map_chip_draw.claim: Reads Room.floor_ at object offset 0x38 and skips the upper-floor draw branch when floor < 1.

map_chip_draw_floor.claim: Draws the RoomData-selected floor image inside the native 14x14 floor-image culling region.

map_chip_draw_extension_floor.claim: Draws the extension-wall/side composition using the MapChip cell and Room dimensions.

coverage.roomdata_to_room_floor_policy: RoomData is passed as an argument; Room.floor_ is supplied by the Room constructor call site.
coverage.full_14x14_native_path: room:0 main display and any floor==0 map construction with width=14,height=14
coverage.native_4x4_nonzero_path: floor!=0 construction with width=4,height=4, including addition-floor preview
unsupported_combinations: floor!=0 with width=14,height=14: MAPCHIP_ARRAY[1] has only 16 values and native InitMapChips cannot supply 196 cells
floor values 2/3/4/5 as distinct topology variants: native selection is boolean floor!=0, not a per-number array index

room_constructor.claim: Room receives width, height, floor, RoomData, and isPreview as separate constructor inputs.

init_map_chips.claim: Readable decompiler body is damaged; native method is authoritative for array selection and dimensions.

addition_preview.claim: Addition-floor preview selects a dynamic RoomData and constructs Room(4,4,1,roomData3,true).
